blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Juan Gomez de Liano registered the fourth triple-double of his rookie season as Converge blew out Titan Ultra, 152-119, to secure the last quarterfinals berth in Group A of the PBA Governors’ Cup on Sunday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Gomez de Liano matched his season-high by scoring 32 points on top of 12 rebounds and 13 assists as the FiberXers improved to a 6-4 win-loss record, enough to book their place in the quarters. His numbers ironically came exactly a year after registering a triple-double in his PBA debut when he had 15 points, 10 rebounds and 11 assists, also […]...
